guarantees.claim: When reset is active-low, processing is forced to 0.
When process_i is asserted, processing is set to 1, regardless of absorbed state.
When process_i is not asserted and prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_test_true_strict(absorbed) is true, processing is cleared to 0.
When not in reset, process_i not asserted, and absorbed not true strict, processing holds its previous value.

assumptions.claim: process_i must be deasserted before or during the assertion of the true-strict absorbed condition, otherwise processing will never clear.
assumptions.cond: During normal operation to exit processing state
assumptions.risk: If process_i remains high while absorbed becomes true, processing stays stuck at 1, causing a deadlock or perpetual busy state.

assumptions.claim: absorbed must be a stable valid mubi4 true encoding when the strict test is evaluated, without glitches or metastable toggling.
assumptions.risk: If absorbed contains an illegal mubi4 value or a glitch, the test may return false, preventing processing from being cleared and causing a hang.

uncertain_points.claim: The priority of process_i over absorbed means that if process_i is asserted exactly when absorbed becomes true, processing may remain high instead of clearing on that cycle.
uncertain_points.cond: process_i high coincident with mubi4_test_true_strict(absorbed) true
uncertain_points.risk: Depending on external control timing, a 1-cycle overlap could cause processing to miss the absorbed completion and stay active, potentially stalling the pipeline or causing protocol violations.
